body_html:
#smallpoems
Do poems exploit key
as metaphor
Do we view humanity locked
behind a door?
answers to see
knowledge blocked
a gate keeper
for heedless answer
seekers
yet what if the key
is a tune not sung
a sum of melodic parts
not a sharp tongue
sounds to unlock
our hearts
#mb
